tavern.legacy_books: hidden migration aliases only; using either converts it to kaleidoscope_cookery:guidebook; no Tavern book recipes or standalone UI

behavior: Publisher sends only public Script Events; it never imports or overwrites Cookery scripts.
A host-ready event triggers one bounded begin/chunk/end transfer; repeated ready events are rate-limited.
Tavern recipes and Cookery recipe registries remain separate; this integration publishes guide content only.
Cookery v1 host owns language selection, root navigation, cancel/back behavior and coexistence with other extensions.
Tavern does not render a second guide UI; Cookery owns navigation, localization and guide presentation.
Tavern extension registry changes republish the same Cookery chapter with add-on guide pages and auto-generated recipe entries.
known_host_limitations: Guidebook API v1 mechanics text has no reliable per-locale mechanicsByLocale path in the verified host; Tavern uses concise Traditional Chinese fallback mechanics while titles/categories/names are localized for zh_CN, zh_TW and en_US.
Minecraft/BDS/mobile/controller rendering still requires real-engine acceptance.

creative_policy.cookery_material_merge: Deferred until exact Cookery Bedrock catalog group identifiers are pinned; no guessed duplicate host groups.
